# Font fixture

`LiberationSans-Regular.ttf` is an **unmodified** Liberation Sans font, copied from
the development system's `fonts-liberation` package. It is used only for tests and
is not bundled in the application.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/liberationfonts/liberation-fonts>
- License and copyright notices: `LICENSE-Liberation.txt` (SIL OFL 1.1)
- SHA-256: `4659bc0c58c5028dd488ec928d41d9265db43d9b669fc14ca8b0832daca7b144`

The fixture exercises real cmap, outlines and OpenType data without relying on
fonts installed on CI machines.

## Fallback fixtures

`FallbackBase.ttf`, `FallbackExtra.ttf`, `FallbackOther.ttf`, and
`FallbackCollection.ttc` contain original geometric test outlines generated by
`tools/build-font-fixtures.py`. No third-party font outlines are included. They
exercise overlapping coverage, Extension J, Nag Mundari, plane-15 private-use
characters, and selecting a noninitial collection face. They are test-only assets.

Regenerate with `uv run --with fonttools tools/build-font-fixtures.py`.

## Glyph variants fixture

`GlyphVariants.ttf` contains original geometric outlines generated by
`tools/build-glyph-fixture.py`. It includes two cmap characters sharing a glyph,
a default UVS and non-default UVS for the same selector, a supplementary VS,
unencoded `liga` and `salt` outputs, an unused glyph, space, and `.notdef`.
The test-only mappings are synthetic and do not assert standardized UVSes.
Regenerate with `uv run --with fonttools tools/build-glyph-fixture.py`.

`StandardizedVariants.ttf` is generated by the same script using those original
outlines. It adds `4E38 FE00`, `0030 FE00`, and `1D49C FE00/FE01` for standardized
sequence name lookup, including a default UVS. The deliberately unregistered
`4E38 FE01` shares a glyph with `4E38 FE00` to check that names are matched to the
full sequence, not merely its base character or glyph ID.

`VariationScopes.ttf` adds registered SVS and IVS, several sequences sharing a
glyph, default UVS, a missing default base, an explicit `.notdef` mapping, emoji
presentation, and unregistered pairs. `VariationPages.ttf` adds the first 140
registered IVSes from the pinned data, mapping them to one glyph to exercise
pagination and independent selection. Both are generated by
`tools/build-glyph-fixture.py` and use the same original geometric outlines.


## Localized font names

`LocalizedNames.ttc` and `OnlyOtherNames.ttf` use the existing original geometric
fallback outlines with Japanese, English, Catalan, and Spanish name records.
They exercise UI-language priority, English fallback, stable PostScript identity
when neither language exists, and selecting names from the matching TTC face.
No Windows/Arial data is included. Regenerate with
`uv run --with fonttools tools/build-font-name-fixtures.py`.

## Reverse chaining substitutions

`ReverseChaining.ttf` is generated by `tools/build-reverse-gsub-fixture.py` with
original geometric outlines. It covers GSUB type 8, reverse traversal, backtrack
and lookahead contexts, extension lookups, and ignored combining marks. It
contains no data from Nishiki-teki. Regenerate with
`uv run --with fonttools tools/build-reverse-gsub-fixture.py`.
